launches.title: Clueso Agents: Ship product videos automatically, whenever you ship features.
launches.tagline: Launch videos, product demos, help tutorials, and more - all created automatically with every release.
launches.body:
Every new feature needs a launch video, help tutorial, sales demo, and more such content.

Clueso Agents automate the entire video production pipeline. From generating screen recordings of your product to voiceovers, motion graphics, and visuals that match your brand style.

With Clueso Agents, your content team can ship as fast as your engineering team does.

[**https://youtu.be/2rio5VoUUV8**](https://youtu.be/2rio5VoUUV8)

**🔴 The Problem**

Videos are the best way to communicate your product’s value.

But they’re still created manually. For every new feature, your content team has to figure out what’s new, screen record the product, and edit the video with motion graphics and animations.

The result is a permanent backlog. By the time content is ready, the product has already moved on.

Tools like Loom and Screen Studio help you move faster, but only by compromising on quality.

**🟢 The Solution**

Instead of manually producing every video, let Clueso Agents ([**clueso.io/agents**](http://clueso.io/agents)) handle the entire production pipeline.

Here's how it works:

1. **Connect your product:** Give Clueso login credentials to your product or connect with GitHub, and provide one reference video that represents your brand style.
2. **Every release becomes a trigger:** Clueso understands what changed and creates production plans for new features. It can also identify outdated videos in your existing library.
3. **Our agent screen-records your product:** It logs into your product, navigates through the workflows, and captures polished screen recordings of the features you want to show. Fully autonomously.
4. **AI handles the entire edit:** Along with the recordings, Clueso generates the voiceover, beautiful motion graphics, zooms and visual effects, captions, music, and applies your brand style.

You can also build workflows in Claude with the Clueso MCP, so video creation becomes just another step in your existing automations.

**Why we're building this**

Over the last two years, we built an AI video editor for product videos. Along the way, after working with 1,000+ SaaS companies, we realized editing wasn’t the only bottleneck.

The hard part was understanding what changed in the product, figuring out what to show in the demo, recording it cleanly, and keeping an entire video library up to date as the product evolved.

We’ve now replaced our recording extension with a browser agent that captures the recordings for you.

One customer recently rolled out a complete UI redesign that left nearly 700 videos out of date. With Clueso Agents, they refreshed the entire library in days instead of months.

To learn more and get started for free, book a demo with us at clueso.io/agents.

We can’t wait to show you agents in action!

launches.title: Clueso: Product Videos in Minutes with AI
launches.tagline: Your product ships fast. Your videos should too.
launches.body:
Hey all, we’re [Akash](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theakashanand/), [Prajwal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prajwalprakash2000/), and [Neel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neelbalar7/) from Clueso!

**TL;DR:** Introducing Clueso – AI that turns any rough screen recording, document, or slide deck into a stunning video in minutes.

https://youtu.be/OlOVMA06tpA

## 🔴 The Problem

Organizations today need to produce more videos than ever, for a variety of use cases:

* product demos
* marketing and feature launches
* customer onboarding
* internal training
* sales enablement
* product, process, and workflow training

… and so much more.

But creating these videos is time-consuming and requires specialized skills. And despite all the effort, engagement is usually low.

## 🟢 The Solution

Clueso solves this. Our AI turns any rough screen recording, document, or slide deck into a stunning video in minutes.

No design skills required.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=95851&key=user_uploads/1159730/9a6519b7-57f7-498c-ba0d-ab1ea1a07e1d)

Clueso can **write** your video’s script, add a studio-quality **voiceover**, and auto-generate visual **effects**, transitions, branding, and captions – all while giving you full editing control.

It can even **translate** your videos into 50+ languages with one click.

With this launch, we’re also introducing a suite of AI-first tools to **automate** the most time-consuming parts of the video editing process.

With a single prompt, Clueso can now:

* **break down long recordings** like sales calls, webinars, or internal training calls, into bite-sized, polished videos
* **generate** entire videos from documents and slide decks
* **blur out** sensitive customer data from your screen recordings
* create videos that match your brand or any design from our growing **template** library
* generate **step-by-step docs** & SOPs from any screen recording

Multiple teams at 1,000+ startups and enterprises already use Clueso for a variety of use cases.

Sign up today for free at [clueso.io](http://clueso.io)!

launches.title: Clueso: AI-powered product videos and documentation in minutes
launches.tagline: Screen recording -> how-to articles crafted by AI and studio-quality videos with AI voiceovers
launches.body:
### **TL;DR:**

> Clueso helps teams create stunning product documentation in a fraction of the time.  Our tool converts simple screen recordings into comprehensive articles and kickass product videos. 
>
> Clueso articles are crafted by AI and come with beautiful GIFs. 
>
> To generate videos, Clueso lets you edit your script and swap your audio-track with a professional, natural-sounding AI voiceover. Videos also come with zoom- in effects, thumbnails, and custom branding – everything you need for a great video without any of the effort.

Hi everyone! We are Akash, Prajwal, and Neel, the team behind [Clueso](https://clueso.io/).

## **🔴 The Problem**

High quality educational content on products and processes isn’t a nice-to-have: it's a necessity. From knowledge base articles and feature launch videos to internal SOPs and employee training material, there's a constant need for videos and articles in any organization. 

But creating this content is time-consuming and expensive:

* Loom videos require several retakes to get the perfect output and, even so, don’t look professional or engaging enough.
* If you’ve ever created documentation  for your product, you know how painful it is to capture screenshots and find the right words.

And when a guide goes out-of-date, you need to put the same effort all over again!

## **🟢 The Solution**

Clueso streamlines your entire workflow to create  product videos and documentation.

**Creating User Guides**

Simply capture a screen recording while talking through any feature or flow on your product. Clueso instantly gives you:

* **Step-by-step articles:** Clueso snaps GIFs/screenshots, and AI drafts your guide automatically. No matter who captures the process, get a uniform tone across all articles. \[[Check out a Clueso-generated article](https://www.clueso.io/features/help-articles)\]

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76665&key=user_uploads/1156693/1bc55859-9389-4b24-a054-db1efba881ed)

* **Engaging studio-quality videos:** Update transcripts on-the-fly, and regenerate your video instantly with natural-sounding AI voices. Incorporate zooming-in effects and branded intro, outro, and background elements at a single click. \[[Watch a Clueso-generated video](https://www.clueso.io/features/video-tutorials)\]

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=76665&key=user_uploads/1156693/67d98602-2210-4f26-a668-13abd2ecd5cf)


**Updating Content**

When your product or process changes, simply re-record the updated flow and Clueso magically updates all related documentation. Don’t worry about swapping screenshots or explaining the same terms again. 

**Use Content Anywhere**

Content created using Clueso can be exported anywhere or hosted on a Clueso powered help center or team workspaces.

## **Our customers use us for creating…**

1. how-to guides and videos for knowledge base
2. SOPs for internal team training 
3. onboarding videos
4. feature launch videos for landing pages and social media
5. and sharing guides for ad-hoc customer queries

Basically, anywhere you need videos or articles: Clueso has got your back.

## **Our quick asks**

* [Book a demo](https://calendly.com/clueso_intro/neel) with us if you want to learn more about Clueso and use it for creating product documentation, videos or a help center.
* Refer us to anyone you know who’s on the lookout for a solution to improve their customer education or internal team training. Our inbox is always open [founders@clueso.io.](mailto:founders@clueso.io)
* Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/clueso) or [Twitter](https://twitter.com/_Clueso) for new product updates and customer education best practices.

launches.title: 🚀 Clueso : Create in-app tours that never go out-of-date
launches.tagline: One screen recording → Help guides in three formats!
launches.body:
Hey there! We’re [Prajwal](https://www.linkedin.com/in/prajwalprakash2000), [Neel](https://www.linkedin.com/in/neelbalar7/), and [Akash](https://www.linkedin.com/in/theakashanand), and we are very excited to launch [Clueso](https://clueso.io) to all of you!

**TL;DR:** Clueso helps customer success teams save time creating and maintaining help content for SaaS apps. Our product converts simple screen recordings of product features into interactive product tours and how-to guides that stay up-to-date with every product release. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70052&key=user_uploads/1159730/adc0642c-6d2c-44cd-b4e3-7e18691a78fe)

### [**🔴**](https://emojipedia.org/large-red-circle/) **The Problem**

Users of SaaS apps have a hard time discovering new features and finding what they’re looking for, even on products with a well-designed UX.

Creating help guides on tools like Intercom is time-consuming – you have to put together screenshots, write out instructions, and make everything look presentable. Making interactive tours is even more work.

And what happens when you deploy new UI updates? All your hard work goes down the drain, and you have to start from scratch.

### [**🟢**](https://emojipedia.org/large-green-circle/) **Our Solution**

Clueso lets you create help guides for product features in seconds rather than hours. Here’s how it works:

**Step 1:** 

Use our chrome extension to capture a simple screen recording of some feature on your app. 

**Step 2:**

That’s it; you’re done! 

Clueso automatically generates help guides in three formats: a document with screenshots, a video, and an interactive tour that points users to the exact buttons they need to click on your app.

**Wanna see it in action?** Check out this 2-min demo: [Clueso Demo](https://www.loom.com/share/964797a5cf6c4582b5ffb5ccca662abf)

To serve all these guides to your users, **insert a single line of code** to add our help widget to your app. Your users’ experience looks something like this:

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70052&key=user_uploads/1159730/182a84cf-6ce7-4f5b-aa2f-695a47b208a8)

### 🤯 **But wait, there’s more!**

No more waiting for angry customers to come tell you your docs are out of date!

With every new update on your app, all guides are automatically tested. Outdated guides are flagged so that you know exactly which ones need to be reworked.

### **Meet the team**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=70052&key=user_uploads/1159730/f606bc26-46b2-4218-af78-465829b49618)

We’re a team of recent grads from IIT Madras. Before Clueso, our team built and scaled [Desklamp](https://desklamp.io) – a note-taking tool for students and researchers – to 2k MAU from around the world. We experienced this problem first-hand with Desklamp, where our users would repeatedly email us similar questions about how to use the product. Prajwal (middle) has a bachelor’s in Computer Science, while Neel (left) and Akash (right) have a bachelor’s in Engineering Design and a master’s in Data Science. 

### **Our Ask**

* If you’d like to give your users an interactive way to learn your app or discover new features, reach out to us at [founders@clueso.io](mailto:founders@clueso.io) or schedule a chat with us here: [calendly link](https://calendly.com/clueso/30min?month=2023-03).
* If you know of someone else who may be interested, especially customer success managers at seed-stage+ start-ups, we’d love an intro!
